purpose: Bounded word checks of the typed entrypoints of the three profiles, each weakened in an isolated copy of the product, with the outcome that the word guard probe must observe.
decoderBoundary: The sources hold no statement that checks a bounded word. The compiler checks every read of an address, uint64, uint48 or enum field of a request struct in calldata and rejects a value that does not fit with empty revert data, including the copy of the action request to memory. A mutant therefore rewrites the source of an isolated copy so that one kind of field is read without that check, or without its width part or its range part for a kind field.

mutants.fault: Read the four address words of an action request truncated to 160 bits instead of rejecting a word with dirty high bits
Read the dependency and authority epoch words of both requests truncated to 64 bits instead of rejecting a word with dirty high bits
Read the two validity time words of both requests truncated to 48 bits instead of rejecting a word with dirty high bits
Accept every action kind word below 256 instead of only the six declared kinds
Accept every reversal kind word below 256 instead of only the three declared kinds
mutants.rationale: Every endpoint checks the reversal pairing before any external call and accepts only UNFREEZE after FREEZE, RELEASE after SEIZE and UNRESTRICT after RESTRICT, so a reversal kind outside the declared range ends in the pairing failure whether or not the decoder checks the kind word.

mutants.fault: Read the action kind word truncated to eight bits instead of rejecting a word with dirty high bits; converting the truncated value to the kind still rejects a value outside the six declared kinds
Read the reversal kind word truncated to eight bits instead of rejecting a word with dirty high bits; converting the truncated value to the kind still rejects a value outside the three declared kinds

nonclaim: Each mutant changes the sources of an isolated copy of the product only; the published runtimes are unchanged.
